text:
marta: quick lab note — multiple testers confused whether the SLO "threshold" field expects percent or raw counts while they were typing. screenshot coming.

evelyn: saw same. user typed 80 then checked preview and it showed 80 requests; they assumed % wasn't applied.

sam: can you paste steps to repro? i'll look at component state.

marta: repro: edit SLO > focus threshold > type `80` quickly > toggle metric selector > unit label blinks out until blur; preview sometimes shows route default metric instead of the SLO override. chrome + mac.

ashwin: sounds like a re-render race. frontend only shows unit after blur; backend canonicalizes pct as fraction (0-1) so we need client-side normalization.

evelyn: design suggestion: add a faint trailing unit chip inside the input while focused (visual only) + helper text under field: "e.g., 95% or 1000 requests".

sam: implement note: accept `95`, `95%`, `0.95` and normalize before POST. simple parser: strip `%`, if metric==pct and value>1 divide by 100. will add unit tests.

a11y-bot: accessibility: visual-only unit must be included in the accessible name. Use aria-describedby to point to a visually-hidden element with the unit text. Use role="status" for validation errors so screen readers announce them. Also ensure helper/error contrast meets AA for small text (>=4.5:1) or increase size.

kai: copy nit: change label to "Alert threshold" and show helper beneath. keeps label concise but clearer.

marta: agreed. action items: 1) inline trailing unit chip while focused, 2) helper example copy ("e.g., 95% or 1000 requests"), 3) parser + client normalization, 4) preview must prefer explicit SLO unit over route default, 5) a11y checklist (aria-describedby, role=status, contrast). i'll update Figma and post link.

evelyn: please include two copy options in the spec; i'll pick final.

sam: ping me when spec is live and i'll open a PR.

ashwin: i'll add telemetry events `slo_threshold_normalized` and `slo_preview_metric_mismatch` to monitor regressions.

a11y-bot: reminder: test with NVDA/VoiceOver and keyboard-only nav. mark decorative elements aria-hidden and expose accessible text elsewhere.

marta: thanks all — posting Figma + copy by EOD. :sparkles:
